qt: to the Commission Erik Marquardt (Verts/ALE) Subject:

A report by the NGO Collectivo Rotte Balcaniche1 documents testimonies from asylum seekers at the Bulgarian Pastrogor Transit Centre of police violence, inadequate access to medical care and food, the destruction of mobile phones and a ban on visitors. 1.
What is the Commission’s knowledge of these allegations? Has it contacted the Bulgarian authorities about the matter?
What does it make of the conditions described in view of the new Reception Conditions Directive?
What findings has Bulgaria’s independent human rights monitoring body reported to the Commission about the centre to date?
